acceptanceCriteria: The darwin lock holder is identified exactly or labelled approximate in the finding, with a test.
The lsof probe stays within its bound at load 60+ or degrades to a narrower probe, measured.
A Linux run (CI or VM) retains live /proc probe evidence.
The notify hook runs after the cache lock is released, with a test.
Host coverage gaps for EARLY_REFUSAL/HOST_RETRY_STORM are closed or declared in the spec.
body: PR #1060 delivered TQD-V0-020..024/026..033. Residuals: (1) darwin approximates the lock holder by the longest-running opener; (2) the darwin lsof probe often exceeds its 5 s bound under load, so doctor warns and produces no finding; (3) Linux /proc probes are covered only by parser fixtures; (4) the notify hook runs while holding the cache lock; (5) EARLY_REFUSAL cannot fire for opencode and HOST_RETRY_STORM cannot fire for claude-code; (6) no cross-run scan cache; (7) the LiveFormats change means an in-place replacement of an older build needs a drain.
title: doctor: exact darwin lock holder, lsof bound under load, live Linux probe evidence, notify outside the cache lock (V1-1598 residuals)
